summary: Extracts, remaps, smooths, and deletes profile curves, usually after projecting trim curves onto spline surfaces.
common_gotchas: Profile SOP ignores non-profile primitives, so the group pattern must name the intended profile curves.
Parametric extracts are useful for editing but should not be assumed to sit on the source surface in 3D space.
Invisible profiles outside the active domain can still affect later trim/bridge/profile workflows unless removed.
key_concepts: Profile SOP operates on profile curves, commonly after Project SOP creates profiles on a spline surface.
Extract and Remap are distinct operations: extraction can create planar analytical geometry, while remap changes profile parameterization.
Parametric extraction produces XY-domain geometry and does not guarantee spatial coincidence with the original surface location.
Profiles outside a 0-1 surface range can be invisible while still existing unless deleted.
